archetypes.name: dyn-wait-contract
archetypes.rationale: Shared wait prose carries pinned behavior contracts despite compression.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the compressed `skills/shared/design-background-wait.md` for semantic drift in `/design` background-wait behavior. Focus on empty-output handling, one-probe recovery, duplicate notification handling, and terminal-sentinel routing. Verify protected literals remain in the correct sections and still give actionable instructions. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-closure-baseline
archetypes.rationale: The regenerated closure ratchet must reflect only the intended design shrink.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect `python/skill-closure-baseline.json` against the markdown change. Confirm the design closure metrics decreased as expected and implement closure rows did not change unexpectedly. Check that the baseline was generated, not hand-edited, based on formatting and surrounding rows. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
